authenticity.evidence: Heavy bundling: GMGN tags 37 bundler wallets, which make up about 63% of top-trader activity, and the bot/degen share is 67%. The buyer/seller split is extremely lopsided: 2,059 unique buyers against only 59 unique sellers in 30 minutes. That pattern points to scripted many-wallet buying, not organic traders. The creator has already closed out. There is no website, no socials and no DexScreener profile. The only link is a Beff Jezos tweet, which the narrative piggybacks on.
